title: Day in the Life of Lindsey: A McGill Arts & Science Student 📚🧶✨
description:
Join Lindsey, a U3 Bachelor of Arts & Science student majoring in Cognitive Science and minoring in International Development Studies, as she takes you through a day in her life at McGill University! 

From working on campus as a student ambassador to meeting with her thesis supervisor and balancing her extracurricular activities, Lindsey gives you an inside look at how she juggles academics, work, and personal interests.
